title: CombatContracts
description: Turn PvP into rotating contracts with a clean GUI and configurable rewards.
body:
CombatContracts gives players a reason to keep fighting beyond normal kills. Players open `/contracts` to view three active PvP contracts in a clean menu, claim the ones they want, unclaim the ones they do not want active, and refresh for a new set.

The plugin comes with a larger default contract pool, including weapon kills, low-health wins, killstreaks, revenge kills, projectile kills, and basic bounty-style kill goals. Server owners can edit existing contracts or add their own in the config. Rewards are command-based, so the plugin works on its own and can also fit servers that already use crates, ranks, keys, items, XP, or economy commands.

It is made for SMPs, lifesteal servers, factions servers, PvP arenas, and survival servers that want more action without installing a giant quest system.

## Features

- Clean `/contracts` inventory GUI
- Three separated contract books with neat hover info
- Claim and unclaim contracts by clicking their book
- Claimed contracts glow
- Unclaimed contracts do not progress
- Bottom-middle refresh button for new contracts
- 15 default contracts included
- Easy config editing for custom contracts
- Configurable command rewards
- Weapon, low-health, streak, revenge, projectile, and basic kill contracts
- Anti-farm protection for repeated kills
- Works without Vault or any economy plugin
- No extra dependencies

## Commands

- `/contracts` opens the contracts GUI
- `/contracts reroll` gets new contracts
- `/contracts reload` reloads the config
- `/contracts reset <player>` resets a player's contracts

## Permissions

- `combatcontracts.use` lets players use `/contracts`
- `combatcontracts.admin` lets staff use `/contracts reload`, `/contracts reset <player>`, and admin reroll bypasses
